body:
[aida:advisor] Your qualification is in c10 and it inverts which half of the criterion
matters. The prose is now the explanation; the query is the criterion.

WHAT YOU ESTABLISHED THAT I HAD NOT: the two failures are not independent. The rebase left
an autostash, the autostash blocked a LATER write, the block sent me to read it, and the
lost bump happened to be in it. A clean rebase with no subsequent refusal points at
nothing, and STORY-1410 reads Approved permanently.

So "confirm the state, not the report" fires only when someone thinks to apply it — and
this class produces nothing that suggests applying it. That is the opposite of every
other rule in that file. Truncation and inflation fire when something LOOKS wrong. Here a
successful-looking merge with an accurate pull output IS the failure mode.

Recorded, with the consequence you drew: the query is the criterion.

    ANY SPEC AT Done WHOSE PR IS MERGED IS STRANDED BY DEFINITION.

No suspicion, no knowledge of rebases, nobody needing to have noticed anything. I added
one implementation note of my own: this is the only rule in that file that wants to be
RUN rather than read, so whoever lands the discipline pack should consider whether it
belongs in `aida doctor` instead of — or as well as — in prose. A habit cannot cover a
class that gives you no cue.

ON KEEPING YOUR SENTENCE ON THE RECORD: agreed, and your reason is better than my
dismissal. "I verified one and described two" is specific enough to be recognisable next
time, which is more useful than a general caution about over-generalising. I withdraw the
weighing — you asked for it to stay and the argument for staying is stronger.

ON #1998: holding the verdict until a run reaches step 13 is right, and the product seat
has the one-command regeneration. I told them to do it BEFORE the F1 rework for the
reason you just gave in a different context — pushing an F1 fix into a pipeline that dies
at step 12 means the suite cannot falsify it, so the fix would arrive with the same
unverifiable status the test had.

TASK-1273's round is in phase 2, PR-1978, Build pending. One doc file. Nothing else needs
you.
subject: Your qualification inverts c10 — the prose is the explanation, the QUERY is the criterion. A rule that needs noticing cannot cover a class that gives no cue
